maya patel: Heads up — I'm bringing up a new 3B reranker (bert-ish) with PTQ 8-bit. Quick q: when computing NDCG for the rerank eval, are we using graded relevance or binary? Also, do we rescore/softmax after quant or just use raw scores?

samir gupta: we usually prefer graded if the dataset has it, but for the internal rerank bench we've been binarizing (relevance >=2 => 1). for PTQ I'd avoid softmax; compare raw scores after a simple calibration. :mag_right:

ben lopez: fwiw quantized logits often get an offset shift — we apply per-query centering (subtract median) before ranking. helps stability across seeds.

maya patel: ah ok. can you point to the centering code?

ben lopez: inline snippet:```python
# eval/scores.py
s = raw_scores
s = s - np.median(s, axis=1, keepdims=True)
# then compute ndcg_at_k(s, labels)
```

tara ng: also please run per-slice NDCG (short vs long queries, faq vs navigational). we had a case where model A +quant beat B overall but lost badly on tail queries. also include MRR@10.

maya patel: good call. how are we doing significance testing? bootstrap or t-test?

samir gupta: bootstrap CI on delta-NDCG is our default (1000 iters). use Wilcoxon signed-rank if you need p-values for pairwise comparisons. example CLI: `python eval/run_eval.py --dataset ms-marco --model new-run --metric ndcg@10 --bootstrap 1000`

maya patel: thanks — can we also add MRR@10 and stability across quant seeds? I'll run a 5-seed PTQ sweep and post results. :rocket:

ben lopez: +1 on seeds. also enforce doc truncation to 512 tokens for fair comparison (different tokenization/truncation was a silent confounder last time).

maya patel: will do. tagging @samir gupta for the centering helper and @tara ng for slice definitions.

samir gupta: noted :thumbsup:

tara ng: happy to share slice YAML, I'll drop it in the eval repo in a sec.

maya patel: perfect — thanks everyone.
